note: Path prefixes whose contents are claims about Logic. A change touching one of these may not use the opt-out in a pull request body, whatever its description says. Read from a file rather than held as a tuple so the merge-base ratchet can see it, and because a NEW directory that declares a LabelSet must be added here in the same change -- check-canon-citations.py refuses one that is not. A file NAMED in `exceptions` is not Logic-facing even though its path sits under one of these prefixes; see that key.
exceptions_note: Files under a Logic-facing prefix that state no fact about Logic: they hold job names, guard names, test counts and the numbers a document may state. A change touching only these may use the `states no fact about Logic` opt-out, because there is no row of Apple's data such a change rests on and the alternative is pasting a citation that resolves and quoting its value in the diff -- manufacturing evidence, which is what the citation rule exists to stop. Measured 2026-09-20 (#937): the rule made a four-line correction to GUARD-TESTS-BLIND-TO-THEIR-GUARD.json unmakeable and pushed a new ratchet file out of docs/canon for no reason but this. THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK, and check-canon-citations.py refuses an entry whose file carries a logic-canon:// reference or quotes a value the corpus holds -- a file that cites Logic is not a file that states no fact about it.
